pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [376, 651, 444, 879] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: The pedestrian remains completely stationary throughout the 15-frame sequence with no preparatory movements, weight shifts, or head turns toward traffic that would indicate crossing intention.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are standing still on the sidewalk facing away from traffic, showing no signs of movement or awareness of the approaching vehicle.
